testcase.name: Scenario: Report no matching feature search results: tmp/obk-browser-find-MoCBwC/source/features/application/model-browser/model-browser.feature:376:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Report no matching feature search results ✔ Given a part with one unsuppressed extrusion and no fillet is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And the Find dialog contains Type equals Extrusion OR Type equals Fillet ✔ And And is selected for additional criteria ✔ When the user selects Suppress status as the property ✔ Then the condition is equals and the value is Suppressed ✔ When the user clicks Add to list ✔ Then the criteria list includes Suppress status equals Suppressed ✔ When the user clicks Find Now ✔ Then an information message says that no objects matched the criteria ✔ When the user acknowledges the message ✔ Then the Find dialog remains open with the criteria displayed ✔ When the user closes the Find dialog ✔ Then the block remains visible in the same apparent view
